message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is a gas‑giant exoplanet that is roughly 15–20 times the mass of Jupiter (about 0.015–0.02 solar masses). It is often cited as **HD 100546 b** (sometimes also referred to as “PDS 70 c” when discussing similar massive planets). This planet is about 1.5–2 times the radius of Jupiter and is located at a distance of roughly 10–12 AU from its host star.
